facts.text: On the sealed project_context eval (primary qrels, nDCG@10, paired bootstrap), `rrf_v2` beats `dense_v2` by +0.144 [+0.077, +0.214], decision 'better' (fusion beats dense on v2).
On the sealed project_context eval (primary qrels, nDCG@10), `rrf_v2` beats `rrf_v1` by +0.293 [+0.194, +0.394] and `dense_v2` beats `dense_v1` by +0.271 [+0.173, +0.364]; both decided 'better'.

Under strict (min of grades) and lenient (max of grades) qrels, the `rrf_v2` vs `dense_v2` delta stays 'better' (+0.151 [+0.076, +0.222] strict; +0.146 [+0.078, +0.214] lenient), so decisions are unchanged while values shift slightly.

Downstream A/B: arm A (tools read,grep,find,ls plus `project_context`) minus arm B (no `project_context`) gives pass-rate delta -0.067 [-0.333, +0.200], 'not established'; arm A called `project_context` 0 times in 15 runs.

Exploratory forced-use arm F (prompted to call `project_context` first, same tools as A) minus B gives pass delta -0.200 [-0.400, +0.000], 'not established', with one `project_context` call per question.
Inter-judge agreement on 1485 pooled items: Cohen kappa unweighted 0.679, linear-weighted 0.735, quadratic-weighted 0.800.
Binary (rel>=1) judge agreement is kappa 0.766; 230 disagreements (5 of them 2-vs-0) were adjudicated by two adjudicator subagents, who reported they did not open the source for every disagreement.

The pool takes the top 10 from each of 7 arms (rg, memory, dense_v1, rrf_v1, dense_v2, bm25_v2, rrf_v2) for each query, yielding 1485 unique (query, doc) pairs over 42 queries, split into judge-batch-0..5 and judged in judgments-A and judgments-B.

Mining funnel in `eval/mine-stats.json`: 1982 raw search events, 0 parse failures, 1848 non-tuning, 1730 usable secret-free text, 1463 with follow-up files, 761 after Jaccard-0.8 dedup, 733 after removing prior-query overlap; split dev 498 (23 sessions), test 235 (22 sessions).
`eval/select.py` stratifies test queries with seed 20261018 into 22 identifier, 10 phrase and 8 regex queries, and keeps every memory_history test query.

`eval/mine.py` marks a session as tuning when any tool-call argument matches `h2h|project_context|memory-audit|rag-eval|heldout`, and drops queries with token Jaccard >= 0.5 against h2h-questions.json, heldout-questions.json or scan-global.json queries.
Leak check result in `eval/leak-check.txt`: 0 sessions span both dev and test splits, 0 test queries come from tuning sessions, and 0 test texts are identical to a dev text.

`eval/SEAL-queries.txt` pins sha256 b1af453539bc923e7b1887198575029453546a75713a3ca8944eaf28e1771230 for `eval/queries.jsonl` and 6497123dcc81cad92005ef058b2ed13233f67aaaf84fac90e6bb2b14be038526 for `eval/test-queries.jsonl`, both produced by mine.py and select.py.

`node tools/e2e/project-context-eval.mjs` checks the sealed hashes in SEAL-queries.txt, SEAL-runs.txt and SEAL-qrels.txt (46 files), reproduces `scoring/scores.txt`, and reproduces `ab/ab-scores.txt` and `ab/ab-scores-F.txt` from raw runs; it needs `artifacts/memory-audit/.venv`.
